review_type: read-only cross-page notation QA; advisory findings only

scope.method: All accepted pages scanned for recurring notation controls and balanced unsure units; all page-record notation and final doubt fields compared; ambiguous coverage candidates reviewed in context. Targeted visual review of 13 existing crops on five pages. This is not a fresh full-page transcription pass.

findings.title: Gamma on 067 is consistent; 053 remains a local sigma/gamma doubt
findings.observation: The clear gamma=4 has a low closed loop and a raised right arm. The edge labels and dark algebra show the same family with variable arm height; some gamma-prime forms have a nearly flat upper return. The 053 side-note symbol has a low oval and long flat upper return. That local shape does not exclude gamma when compared with 067; it also remains sigma-like. The overwritten mark beside the 067 quotient divisor is a separate unresolved feature.
findings.recommendation: Keep gamma consistently on 067 and retain the quotient/index doubt. Do not globally replace the 053 sigma/gamma alternatives. Qualify the consolidated gamma row so its inclusion of 053 explicitly refers to an unresolved sigma/gamma occurrence, rather than seeming to certify gamma there.
findings.confidence: high for the consistency assessment on 067; medium for the 053 local assessment

findings.title: The Sigma summary omits the 064 bar alternative and the 056 live accent doubt
findings.observation: The cancelled 056 opening has a visibly separated wavy accent. The live 056 pi-zero formula has an extra curved upper run close to the main top bar, supporting the existing tilde/plain doubt. In 064 the tuple has crowded bracket and accent strokes; its local doubt remains appropriate. The marginal opening has a flatter detached upper run, consistent with retaining the bar as an explicit alternative. Accepted 064 TeX and final record doubts already include that bar alternative, but the 064 notation row and generated working/hand rows still list only tilde/plain and describe both locations together. The consolidated decoration row omits 056 and does not mention the 064 bar alternative.
findings.recommendation: Refresh the 064 notation/hand row to distinguish the tuple from the marginal sign. Add the bar alternative for the margin and mention the 056 live tilde/plain doubt in the consolidated decoration summary. Preserve the accepted TeX and final local doubts.
findings.confidence: high for the metadata mismatch; local source doubts remain unresolved

findings.title: 061 dotted divisibility, primes, lower indices and item number are separate readings
findings.observation: The raised item-2 heading has two small dots to the left of an upright; the lower main divisor relation has no corresponding pair of dots. The r-primes are detached upper-right strokes, while the a indices are separate low loops. The small 2-like mark after the divisor condition sits below the relation baseline and is not a secure exponent. In item 3 the target first and last Z have no separate a; the multiplier has a long lower exit without a securely separable a, hence d/d_a. The first main item digit is heavily retraced and may look like 4 despite its sequential place; the current 4-degree/1-degree doubt is appropriate. These forms all have final doubt mappings where needed.
findings.recommendation: Keep the local dotted and undotted relation forms and literal uneven indices. Do not infer extra a indices or resolve the item digit by sequence. The working notation and hand logs already describe the dotted divisor; adding it to notation_final would make that local exception easier to find, but no accepted-source correction is proposed.
findings.confidence: high for dots, prime placement and unindexed target Z forms; retained uncertainty for d/d_a, isolated 2-like mark and first item digit

findings.kind: missing individual final doubt mapping in a changing page
findings.title: The small-triangle b_3 doubt needs its own final record entry
findings.observation: The current accepted page contains a standalone unsure b_3 on the small triangle right side. No individual final doubts entry addresses that same local label. The existing b_3^1 entry belongs to an inter-hole label and does not cover this different ink. Whole drawing uncertainty entries concern connectivity rather than this letter/index reading.
findings.recommendation: When 067 adjudication is finalized, add an individual final doubt entry for the small-triangle b_3, or record an explicit resolution if root independently settles it. Do not treat the separate b_3^1 mapping as coverage for this label.
findings.confidence: high as a metadata snapshot; no new glyph adjudication

findings.kind: older notation certainty superseded by explicit final doubts
findings.title: The c_i^0/c_i^1 summaries should reflect the retained c/a/b alternatives
findings.observation: The current page and final doubts retain eight c/a or c/b alternatives at the inter-hole labels. An appended notation row acknowledges the mixed outer/inner strokes and low-confidence c primary, but the earlier record/working/hand row still describes all eight as clearly open c forms, and notation_final still says the eight labels use the visible c forms without the alternatives. The literal pi(j) note is separate and remains correctly qualified.
findings.recommendation: Qualify or explicitly supersede the older c_i row and refresh the consolidated row to say c primary with a/b alternatives. This is a summary-consistency update; no further source decision is proposed.
